Guiana; asst. mast., normal schl., for 2 years; clk. to inspr. of schls., July, 1873, to May, 1877; jun. educnt. dist. offr., May, 1877, to 1882; sen. educnt. offr., 1882 to 1891; 2nd asst. inspr. of schls., 1891 to 1903; acted as 1st asst. ditto on various occasions, 1892-1903; 1st asst. ditto, July, 1903.



ROSS, A. C. J.—Ed. at Ipswich and Blair Lodge schl., Scotland; clerical asst., govt. land dept., B. Guiana, Jan., 1897; 5th cls. clk., pol. dept., May, 1897; 2nd cls. supervisor, cust. prev. serv., G. Coast, Oct., 1899; 1st cls. supervisor, July, 1900; received Roy. hum. soc'y. medal and certif., Jan., 1902; inspr., cust. prev. serv. and trav. consmr., 2nd May, 1902; ag. dist. consmr., Dec., 1906; dist. consmr., West Frontier, 1st Mar., 1907.



ROSS, ALFRED ERNEST CLARENCE.—B. 1856; 2nd clk., surg.-gen.'s offr., Trinidad, 1875; clk. to dir. pub. wks., Feb., 1876; savings bk. clk., recvr.-gen.'s dept., Nov., 1880; acctnt., savings bk., Oct., 1882; sec. to trade and taxes consmr., 1886; acctnt., recvr.-gen.'s dept., May, 1889; cb. mag., savings bk., Jan., 1901; P.M.G., Trinidad and Tobago, Sept., 1903.



ROSS, DAVID ALEXANDER.—Admitted to the bar, Quebec, 1884; Q.C., 1873; in 1878-9 mem. legis. assem. for co. of Quebec; mem. of the exec. coun., atty.-gen., and in 1887-8, mem. legis. coun.



ROSS, GEORGE WM., LL.D., F.R.S.C.—B. 1841; held seat in house of commons, 1872 to 1883; Ontario legislature, 1883 to 1905; apptd. to Senate of Canada, 1905; min. of educn in 1883; was inspr. of pub. schls. from 1871 to 1883; consmr. for Ontario and also for the Dominion to the Ind. and Col. exhib., 1886.



ROSS, JOHN KENNETH MURRAY.—Clercal asst. native dept., Fiji, Sept., 1879; stip. mag., Aug., 1880; ag. res. consmr., Colo West, Oct., 1882; mag., Tailcyn and Ra, Apr., 1887; called to the bar, Fiji, Mar., 1888; ag. res. consmr., Lomaiviti, Aug., 1888; proceeded in July, 1893, to Rototonga and Penrhyn Is. as special judicial consmr., under the W.P. high consmr.; collr. of customs, ch. inspr. of distilleries, etc., Dec., 1896; ag. atty.-gen., May to Sept., 1897; called to the bar, Inner Tem., Jan., 1900; ag. ch. just., June, 1901, to Jan., 1902, and from May to Nov., 1902; ag. atty.-gen., Jan. to May, 1903; mem. exec. coun., Aug., 1903; M.L.C., 1905.



ROSS, PHILIP HEIDELAND.—Ed. at Christ's Coll., New Zealand, Otago Univ. and St. Bartholomew's Hosp.; M.R.C.S., Eng.; L.R.C.P., Lond., 1900; D.P.H., Camb., 1902; bacteriologist, E. Africa and Uganda Prots., Aug., 1903.



ROSS, REGINALD JAMES BLAIR, B.A.—B. 1871; ed. at Gonville and Caius Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Inn. Temp., Apr., 1894; dist. consmr., Lagos, Mar., 1898; ag. pol. mag. on various occasions in 1898, 1899 and 1900; ag. asst. col. sec., 1900; ag. res., Ibadan, Oct., 1901, to Sept., 1902; pol. mag., Jan., 1903; ag. atty.-gen., 1903, 1904 and 1905; ag. judge of sup. ct., Feb. to May, 1905; ag. atty.-gen., S. Nigeria, June to Oct., 1906; ag. puisne judge, Cent. Prov., Oct. to Dec., 1906, and again in 1907; consmr. of Niger lands, Cent. Prov., Apr., 1907.



ROSS, S. B. C.—Ed. Uppingham Schl. (1889-93); Owens Coll., 1893-96; B.A., 1896; (Eng. lang., lit. honours); univ. schlr., 1896-7; prize for Roman Law Constitutl. Law, 1898; cadet, F.M.S., 1899; sent to Canton to study Chinese, 1900; transf'd. to Hong Kong, 1901; ag. registr., land ct., 1902 and 1903; ag. asst. postmrgen., 1903; sec. to consmr. of inquiry into sup. ct. regisy., 1903; ag. asst. P.M.G., 1903; ag. P.M.G., 1903-4; ag. asst. col. sec., and clk. of consms., 1904; ag. pol. mag., New Territory, 1905; ag. P.M.G., Apr., 1907; ag. A.L.O., Tai Po, Aug., 1907.



ROTH, WALTER E.—B.A. (Oxon), late Demy of Magd. Coll.; M.R.C.S., Eng.; L.R.C.P., Lond.; hon. mem. anthrop. societies of Berlin and Florence, and of anthrop. inst., Lond.; late chief protector of aborigines, Queensland; and royal consmr. to inquire into condition of natives of W. Aust.; stip. mag., dep. prot. of Indians, and govt. med. offr., Pomeroon River, B. Guiana, 8th Dec., 1906.



ROTITIMI, J. F. AMOSU.—Ed. Baptist elementary schl. and academy, Lagos; marine clk., Calabar, Oct., 1895; asst. registr. of ct., Calabar, June, 1896; dep. registr. of ct., Jan., 1899; trav. supervisor of native ets., S. Nigeria Prot., Sept., 1901, to Apr., 1907; ditto, E. Prov., S. Nigeria, Apr. 1907.

BOUILLARD, Jean Edmond.—Ed. Roy. Coll., M.A.; and King Henry VIII's Sch., Coventry; called to bar, Mod. Tem., 1891; licent. laws, Paris, 1891; ag. dist. mag., Plaines Willhelms, Maur., Oct., 1892; ag. crown pros., Feb., 1893; crown prov., leg. adv., pol. mag., etc., Seychelles, 4th Sept., 1893; mag., Rodrigues, July, 1892.



ROUND, Francis R., M.A., C.M.G. (1887).—B., 1845; ed. at Marl., and Balliol Coll., Oxford, where he obtained a double 2nd class in mods., and a 2nd in classics in final exam., 1868; apptd., after a compet. exam., clk. in the office of the S. of S. for the Col., Feb., 1869; 2nd class clk., Sept., 1872; accompanied Sir P. Jullian to Mauritius in 1873 as sec. on special mission of inquiry into the civil entabl. and gen. expenditure of that col.; asst. priv. sec. to the Rt. Hon Sir Michael Hicks-Beach, Mar., 1878; priv. sec., 1st Apr., to 27th Apr., 1880; priv. sec. to Mr. Herbert, Jan., 1881; 1st class clk., and financial clk., Dec., 1881; on special service to Br. Bechuanaland and Mauritius, 1886; acted as col. sec., Mauritius, 1886-7; prim. clk., C.O., Mar., 1890; ret., 1895.



ROUFELL, Ernest P.S., D.S.O.—B. 1870; ed. at Marl. Coll.; 2nd lieut. R. Welsh Fus., 1888; transf. to Milford Haven div. R. Engnr. Militia, 1891; cons. agt., Oil Rivers Prot., 1893; transf. to Oil River Irreg., 1894; served in Benin R. exp., 1894 (mentd. in desp.), and in minor operations; asst. consmr., Anglo-German Bound. consm., 1896; political offr., 1897-8; divisional consmr., Cross River div., So. Nig., 1898-1900; Ashanti expdn., 1900-1901; temporary 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 15th July, 1900; asst. sec. to gov't of Malta, 17th Apr., 1905.



ROUSSEAU, James Tod, M.A., Edin.—B., 1860; ent. civ. ser., 1882; asst. sub-intendant of crown lands, Trinidad, 1897; magistrate and warden of Tobago, 1899; sub-intendant of crown lands, 1903; mag. and warden, Tobago, 1904.



ROUTH, Reginald Lamy.—B., 1856; ed. St. Mary's Hall, Southsea, and Cadet School; frigate, H.M.S. "Conway"; extra master's certif., 1893; master of govt. vessels, Lagos, Apr., 1897; asst. marine supt., Lagos, Dec., 1902; ag. marine supt., Dec., 1903; to June, 1904; comdr., H.M.C.S.Y., "Ivy," So. Nigeria, June, 1906; sen. marine offr., E. Prov., S. Nigeria, May, 1907.



ROWDEN, Ernest George.—B., 1874; special mast., roy. coll., Mauritius, Jan., 1898; head-master, Victoria schl., Seychelles, 27th Dec., 1901; inspr. of schls., Seychelles, 1st Mar., 1902; ditto, Gold Coast, 17th Dec., 1904; dir. of educn., 8th Feb., 1906.



ROWELL, Thomas Irvine, C.M.G. (1890), M.D., C.M., Aberdeen.—B., 1841; prin. civ. med. offr., S. Stlttns., July, 1877; and health offr., port of Singapore, J.P.; acted as col. surg. on several occasions from May, 1868, to Mar., 1876; accompanied Sir W. Robinson on mission to invest King of Siam with G.C.M.G., Nov., 1878; registr. of births and deaths, Dec., 1882; and of Mohammedan marriages, Dec., 1883; pres. fisheries inquiry comm., 1887; pres. Singapore mun. coun., 1888-9; ret., 1890.



ROWLAND, J. W., C.M.G. (1897).—B., 1852; asst. col. surg., G. Coast Coll., May, 1880; dist. consmr., Lagos, 1887; col. surg., 1887; retired, 1897.



ROWLEY, Thos., Wm.—B., 1839; ed. Chelt. Coll.; 2nd lieut., 2nd L.I. Regt., Roy. Guernsey Militia; attached to 105th Regt., L.I., at Guernsey for two trainings, and passed school; lieut., Mar., 1840; passed prelim. exam., R.M.C., Sandhurst, A., 1880, and qualifying exam. for line, July, 1881; joined armed constab., N.Z., 1885; transf. to mtd. pol., Jan., 1886; and to N.Z. Artill., Aug., 1886; resig., Aug., 1888; inspr. of roads, Pen., Nov., 1889; asst. collr. land rev., mag. and J.P., Perak, Dec., 1890; ag. mag., Matang, June, 1892; asst. dist. mag., Kuala Kangar, Oct., 1893; ag. dist. mag., Matang, Jan., 1894; ag. supt. of prisons, Apr., 1895; asst. mag., Taiping, Malini, 1898; asst. consmr. of pol., Selang., 1899; ditto, Perak, Mar., 1900; dist. mag. for different districts, Jan., 1903, to Feb., 1904; asst. dist. offr., Matang, Apr., 1905; mag., Taiping, Apr., 1906; dist. offr., coast pen., Sembilan, Jan., 1907.



ROXBURGH, T. Laurence.—Ed. Univ.: clk. petty sess., St. Eliz., Jamaica, 1st Jan., 1896; clk. of cts., 1st Apr., 1888; 1st class clk. in sec.'s office, Jamaica, Jan., 1890; sen. clk., 1892; asst. col. sec., 2nd Jan., 1902; acted col. in Jamaica, 29th Mar. to 10th Apr., 1902; 1st to 21st Nov., 1902; 2nd June to 10th Sept., 1903; Jan. to Mar., 1904; 25th May to 9th June, 1904; and 9th June to 10th Oct., 1906; was maj. Jamaica militia, and was Hon. A.D.C. to Sir A. Hemming, 1898 to 1904; also acted priv. sec. to Sir A. Hemming, Mar. to Aug., 1904; admstr. St. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1906.



ROZAN, Jules.—Spcl. clk., audit. off., Mauritius, 1st Jan., 1870; clk., ditto, 19th June, 1897.



RUSHMER, James.—B., 1876; entered C.O., Oct., 1883; apptd., after exam., library atten., 1st July, 1896.



RUSHTON, Charles Berkeley.—Clk. consmr. of rlwys. dept., W. Aust., Apr., 1896; ch. clk., July, 1896; ag. sec. to comm. of rlwys., 23rd Aug., 1901; sec. to ditto, 18th Oct., 1901.



RUSSELL, Lieut.-Gen. Sir Baker C.F.E., G.C.B., K.C.M.G. (1880), 13th Hussars.—B. 1815; was in command of the troops employed against Sikukuni in S. Africa; A.D.C. to Her Majest. Queen Victoria, 1880; asst. adjt.-gen. for cavalry in the expdn. to Egypt, 1882, where he also commanded the 1st Cavalry brigade.



RUSSELL, Conrad.—Ed. at Balliol Coll., Oxford; apptd. asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, S. of S. for the Colonies, Apr., 1903; ditto to Hon. Alfred Lyttelton, Oct., 1903; ditto to Lord Elgin, Dec., 1905.



RUSSELL, James George, I.S.O. (1901).—B., 1848; master of the sup. ct., S. Australia, Dec., 1878; registr. of V.-Act. of companies of trades unions, 1878; consmr. of inland rev. and ag. regist. of probates, 1884; consmr. of taxes, 1884; of stamps, 1886; consmr. of insolvent, 1889; special mag. local act., Adelaide, 1889; pres. of state bd. of conciliation, 1896; ag. judge of sup. ct., Mar. to Oct., 1897.



RUSSELL, John William Pemberton.—Asst. transport offr., Uganda Prot., 21st Aug., 1899; chief of customs, Apr., 1904; transport offr., 1905.



RUSSELL, Robert, Jun.—B., 1867; Natal exhib. from Pietermaritzburg high schl. to Merton Coll., Oxford, 1885; B.A., M.A., and B.C.L., 1883; called to the bar by the Inn, Temp., 1883; acted as clk. in atty.-gen.'s office, Natal, 1891; asst. inspr. of schls., 1892; sec. to the agt.-gen. for Natal in London, Dec., 1893; acted as priv. sec. to the Rt. Hon. H. Escombe, ex-premier of Natal, during his visit to England, 1897; rep. Natal, along with the agent-gen., on exec. comtee. of S. African products exhib., London, 1907.

RUSSELL, WESTERN FRANCIS, B.A.—Ed. at Cranbrook schl. and Christ Church, Oxford; 2nd cls. math. mods.; 1st cls. math. finals, 1884; 1st cls. prof. (math.) Royal coll., Mauritius, Aug., 1886; ag. sen. prof., 12th Apr. to 28th Nov., 1894; and 1st Aug., 1901, to 17th Oct., 1902; ag. rector, 18th Oct. to 30th Nov., 1902; ag. sen. prof., 27th Mar., 1903, to 8th Feb., 1904; ag. ast. col. sec., 24th Feb., 1904.



RUTLEDGE, THE HON. SIR A., KT. BACH. (1902).—B. 1843; barrister, Queensland, 1878; mem. of legis. assem. since 1878; atty.-gen. from 1883 to 1888; dist. ct. judge, Queensland, 1906.



RYAN, SIR CHARLES LISTER, K.C.B. (1887), C.B. (1881), J.P., Berks.—B. 1831; apptd. astt. examnr., impl. audit office, Mar., 1851; jun. clk. in H.M.'s treasy., Whitehall, Feb., 1852; was priv. sec. to Mr. Disraeli, Sir Stafford Northcote, and Mr. Gladstone; apptd. to audit office as sec., May, 1865; astt. comptroller and auditor, Mar., 1873; comptroller and audr.-gen., June, 1883; was hon. auditor of certain crown cols., ag. on behalf of H.M.'s S. of S. for the cols.; ret. 1896.



SABBEN, FREDERICK.—Ed. Royal Naval Schl.; govt. agt., Fiji, July, 1882; inspr. of imigrts. Jan., 1883; boarding offr., Nov., 1883; bondkeeper, 2nd class clk., and magazine-keeper, Jan., 1884; inspr. of pol., and offr. in charge of gaol, May, 1886; gaoler, Aug., 1887; supt., prisons, Aug., 1903.



SACHSE, HON. ARTHUR OTTO, C.E.—M.L.C. for N.E. Prov., Victoria; min. of pub. instr. since Sept., 1903.



SADLER, SIR JAMES HAYES, K.C.M.G. (1907), C.B. (1902).—Lieut.-Col. Indian Staff Corps; late foreign dept., govt. of India; 1st comsn. 6th July, 1870; served with 61st Foot in Canada and Ireland, and 40th Foot and 33rd Bengal Native Infantry in India; apptd. to polit. dept. in India, July, 1877; astt. agt. to gov.-gen. at Baroda, May, 1881; astt. sec., legis. dept., July to Oct., 1886; Aug. to Oct., 1888, and Apr., 1889, to Dec., 1890; polit. agt. with the ex-Amir of Afghanistan, Apr., 1891; astt., Kotal and Jhalawar, July, 1891; on spec. duty with Prince Damong of Siam, Feb., 1892; polit. agt. and consul at Muscat, Nov., 1892; ag. res. and consul-gen., Persian Gulf, June, 1893; astt. sec., govt. of India, foreign dept., Apr., 1895; polit. agt. and consul, Somaliland Prot., Aug., 1898; ret. from the Indian serv., 1899; continued to be employed as consul-gen., Somaliland, till 1901; comsnr., Uganda Prot., Dec., 1901; comsnr. and comdr.-in-chief, E. Africa Prot., 11th Dec., 1905; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, E. Africa Prot., 9th Nov., 1906.



ST. ALDwyn, 1ST VISCOUNT (created 1906).



OF COLN ST. ALDwyn, RT. HON. SIR MICHAEL EDWARD HICKS BEACH, 9TH BARONET (created 1619), P.C., M.P.—B. 1837; ed. at Eton and Chr. Ch., Oxon, first class in law and modern history at the final exam., July, 1858; B.A., 1858; M.A., 1861; dep.-lieut. for Gloucestershire, 1861; M.P. for E. Gloucestershire, July, 1864; parly. sec. to the poor law bd., Feb., 1868; under S. of S. for the home dept., Aug. to Dec., 1868; ch. sec. to the lord-lieut. of Ireland, and sworn a mem. of the priv. coun., Feb., 1874; admitted to a seat in the cabinet, 1876; S. of S. for Cols., 4th Feb., 1878, to 28th Apr., 1880; chancellor of the exchequer and leader of the House of Commons, 24th June, 1885, to Feb., 1886; ch. sec. to the lord-lieut. of Ireland, Aug., 1886, to Jan., 1887; pres. of the bd. of trade 1888-92; chancellor of the exchequer, 1895-1902; M.P. for W. Bristol, 1886, to Dec., 1906; visited Straits Settlements as umpire in Tanjong Pagar Dock Arbitration, 1905-6.



ST. AUBYN, GEOFFREY PETER.—Called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Apr., 1880; W. circuit, pol. mag., Kingstown, St. Vincent, 1891; mem. legis. coun., 1891; ag. ch. just., June, 1893; ag. treas., Nov., 1893; ag. atty.-gen., Dec. to May, 1894, and Nov., 1895; ag. ch. just., from Nov., 1896, to July, 1898; judge of Turks and Caicos Ilds., July, 1898; ag. commr., 1899, 1900, 1901, 1903, 1904, 1905 and 1906.



ST. JOHNSTON, THOS. REGINALD, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., M.S.A., Lond.—Ed. at Cheltenham coll., Birmingham univ. and Westminster hosp.; res. surg. astt., Leicester infirmary; casualty and ophthalmic house surgeon, Dudley hosp.; res. offr., afterwards astt. med. sup't. under L.G.B.; Lewisham infirmary, Lond.; clin. astt., royal hosp. for women; St. John's hosp. for skin diseases, St. Peter's hosp., and Evelina hosp. for children, Lond.; founded Birmingham univ. vol. corps (attached to 1st vol. batt. Royal Warwick Regt.); govt. med. offr., Fiji, 1907; med. offr., col. hosp., Suva, and visiting med. offr. to the prison.



ST. QUINTIN, C.—Ck. to A.A.G., Griqualand W., 1879; border pol., 1880; ag. sub-inspr., Cape pol., 1884; sub-inspr., Bechuanaland pol., 1884; lieut., Bechuanaland border pol., 1885; inspr. of native reserves and J.P., 1887; store-keeper, 1889.



SAINTSBURY, JOHN SEYMOUR.—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1906; 1st cls. in Evidence, Procedure and Criminal Law, bar exams., 1904; certif. of honour from council of legal educ. at Bar Final, 1905, and a prize of 50L., from the Inn; passed civ. ser. test exam., Barbados, 1882; supernumerary, col. sec.'s off., 1883; in P.O., 1884; 7th clk., P.O., June, 1886; 4th clk., audit offr., Sept., 1890; offr. of cust., Dec., 1890; inland rev. offr., Oct., 1905; ag. pol. mag., dist. "E," July to Nov., 1906.



SALKELD, ROBERT EDWARD.—Late Oxfordshire Light Infantry, comyo.comdr., 3rd K.A.R.; collr., E. Africa Prot., 12th Jan., 1906.



SALOMONS, SIR JULIAN EMMANUEL, K.C., KT. BACH. (1891).—B. 1834; vice-pres., exec. coun., N.S. Wales, 1891; resig., 1893; mem. of legis. coun.; London agent-gen., N.S.W., 1894-1900.



SAMPSON, VICTOR, K.C., B.A., LL.B.—Obtained Cape Univ. Chanc. gold medal for essay on the native question, 1877; M.L.A., Cape Colony, since 1898; atty.-gen., Feb., 1904.



SAMUEL, SILVERIC, I.—Ed. at St. Gregory's Rom. Cath. gram. schl., Lagos; messr. and copyt., educ. off., Oct., 1897; clk. to inspr. of schl., Mar., 1899; sec. to comteer. for exhibtn. of schl. wks., 1902 and 1903; clk. and interpreter to trav. comsnr., Ilesha interior dept., Feb., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., govr.'s off., Aug., 1904.



SAMUELSON, S. O.—Ag. registr. native high ct., Natal, Feb., 1881, to Apr., 1882; ag. Zulu interp., sup. ct., May to June, 1882; clk. and Zulu interp. to R.M., Umlazi div., Oct., 1882; Zulu interp., sup. ct., Feb., 1888; under-secr. for native affairs, 1893; mem. of civ. ser. bd.; 1894-1901; J.P. for colony, 1894.



SANDERS, WM. RUTHERFORD BOGLE.—Cadet, Ceylon, 4th Oct., 1879; pol. mag., 1st Jan., 1888; dist. judge, 1st May, 1896; ag. gov't. agt., N. prov., 21st Apr., 1902; officer of cls. II., 18th July, 1902.



SANDERSON, JAMES.—Ck. to ch. j. Barbados, 1867; clk. to gen. bd. of health, Barbo

COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.



Apr., 1871, also clk. to quarantine bd. in 1880; solr., atty., and proctor, Barbados, in 1873; was deleg. for Barbados to quarantine confce. at Demerara in 1888; govt. dir. on bd. of Barbados rly. co. in 1891.



SANDERSON, STANLEY.—3rd treasy. astt., E. Africa Prot., 1st Oct., 1901; supt. of inland rev. and conservancy, 6th Feb., 1903.



SANDIFORD, CHARLES, C.B. (1903), M.I.A.E., M.I.M.E.—Loco. supt., N.W. rly., India; loco. supt., Uganda rly., 1899.



SANGSTER, GUY HENRY.—B. 1871; served in 2nd Dragoons and 91st Highlanders; astt. supt. pol., Gambia, 1897; ag. supt. of pol., inspr. of prisons, Gambia, 1897; astt. inspr., S. Leone frontier force, 1898; Mendi exped., 1898, mentioned in despatches; ag. dist. comsnr., Kärene, 1899; inspr., S. Leone F.J., June, 1899; W. Africa medal and clasp, S. Leone, 1898-9; Royal Humane Soc.'s bronze medal, 1898; astt. dist. comsnr., S. Leone, Dec., 1899-1900; travelling comsnr., Gambia, Nov., 1900; J.P. and comsnr. of ct. of requests of the col.; field treas., Gambia field force, 1901; special mention in despatches; W. African general serv. medal and clasp; priv. sec. to ag. gov'r. of Gambia; promoted 2nd cls. comsnr.



SANKEY, JOHN.—B. 1867; customs clk., England, Dec., 1886; excise offr., Jan., 1887; 2nd div. clk. in acctnt.-gen.'s dept., June, 1887; ag. astt. P.O. surr., 1897; acctnt., dept. of posts and telegraphs, O.R.C., Sept., 1901; ch. acctnt., ditto, July, 1903.



SARWAR, HAFIZ GHULAM.—Cadet, S.S., Sept., 1897; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan. to June, 1900; and from Sept., 1900, to Nov., 1901; passed final exam., Chinese, July, 1900; 3rd mag., Sing., 29th Apr., 1902; ag. sheriff, deputy-registr., and astt. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; dep. registr., sup. ct., Malacca, May, 1907.



SASSE, HAROLD ST. JOHN.—Ck. col. audit branch, E. and A. dept., 1st Aug., 1902; clk., audit offr., Hong Kong, 21st June, 1905.



SAUER, THE HON. J. W.—Sec. for native affairs in Scanlan ministry, Cape Col., May, 1881; ret. 1884; col. sec., July, 1890, to Jan., 1896; comsnr. of pub. wks., Oct., 1898, to 1900; mem. for George, 1904; min. of pub. wks., 1908.



SAUNDERS, CHARLES JAMES, B.A.—B. 1868; ed. Merchant Taylors and St. John's Coll., Oxon; cadet, S.S., 1891; passed final exam. in Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 2nd astt. prot. of Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Sing., May, 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1896; ag. dist. offr., Penang, Mar., 1897; dist. offr., Malacca, May, 1897; ag. astt. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1897; ag. astt. prot. of Chin., and supt. of Ind. imigrn., Penang, and munic. comsnr. for Penang, 1898; ag. astt. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1898; 2nd astt. prot. of Chin., Penang, Aug., 1898; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., May, 1900; ag. offl. assignee, S.S., Sept. to Dec., 1900; Jan., 1901, to Feb., 1903, and Feb., 1906; sheriff, dep.-registr., supreme court, and astt. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; munic. comsnr. for Sing., Oct., 1900, and Sept., 1903; also ag. prot. of Chin., Sing., Apr., 1904; also astt. supt. of Indian imigrts.; astt. prot. of Chin., Penang, May, 1904; ag. sec. for Chin. affairs, S.S. and F. M.S., Apr., 1907.



SAUNDERS, SIR CHARLES JAMES RENAULT, K.C.M.G., 1906, C.M.G., 1895.—B. 1857; held various appts. in Natal civ. ser., 1876-87, when ratified treaty with Queen of Amatongaland (desps.); res. mag., Eshowe, and J.P. for Zululand, 1888; defined bdry. between Amatongaland and Zululand, 1889 (desps.); variously employed under Zululand Gov't., 1888-95 (desps.), when he was apptd. spec. comsnr. for Trans-Pongoland territory, carried out final act of annexation of that territory and declared British prot. for Amatongaland; acted as res. comsnr. and chief mag. of Zululand, 1896; apptd. chief mag. and civ. comsnr. for prov. of Zululand on its incorporation with Natal, 1897; medal, S. African War, 1899-1902; col. representative of Zululand Lands Delimitation Comsn., 1902, as comsnr. for native affairs, 1905.



SAUNDERS, SIR FREDERICK RICHARD, K.C.M.G. (1897), C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1838; astt. surr., Ceylon, 1857; astt. agt. Trincomalee, July, 1862; astt. to govt. agt. at Kandy, Aug., 1865; dist. judge, etc., Ratnapura, Nov., 1865; astt. to the govt. agt., W. Prov., at Ratnapura, Oct., 1867; inspr.-gen. of prisons, 1874; agt., E. Prov., 1878; agt., W. Prov., 1879; M.L.C., 1879; ag. audr. gen., 1890; treas. and comsnr. of stamps, Oct., 1890; ag. audr.-gen., 1896; ret., 1898.



SAUNDERS, JAMES BERNARD.—B. 1822; harbrmr., Trinidad, Sept., 1894; also J.P. and mag. under harbr. and drogher ordce., regar. of births and deaths for the waters of the Col. coroner under harbrs. ordce., supt. of lighthouses, mem. of quar. authority, comsnr. of pilotage, and supt. of mercantile marine.



SAUVAGE, DANIEL.—Gov't. pilot and astt. port offr., Seychelles, Feb., 1894, and port offr., May, 1897.



SAXTON, GEORGE SHADWELL.—B. 1858; ed. at Clifton Coll.; writer, Ceylon civ. ser., 1878; pol. mag. Haputale, 1887; astt. govt. agent, Mannar, 1887; Chilaw, 1888; dist. judge, Tangalla, 1890; astt. govt. agent, Matale, 1890; Matare, 1899; Kalutara, 1902; govt. agent Sabaragamawwa, 1902; dist. judge, Matare, 1904; govt. agent, Anuradhapura, Dec., 1906; ditto, Kurunegala, Oct., 1907.



SAYER, W. F.—Ed. Univ. Coll. Sch., Lond.; solr., 1879; bar. and solr. in W. Australia, 1891; sec. law dept., Mar., 1897; ag. comsnr. of titles, Mar., 1898; atty.-gen., 1901; partly, draftsman, 1902; crown solr., Dec., 1902; atty.-gen., 1904.



SCANLEN, THE HON. THOMAN CHARLES, K.C.M.G. (1884).—B. 1834; mem. house of assem., Cape, since 1869; dep. sheriff for Cradock, 1875-76; J.P. for Cradock, May, 1869; mem. of the dist. coun. of Cradock, 1867-77; comsnr. elecm. of the municipality of Cradock, 1870-77; apptd. by sup. ct. examr. for admission of attorneys and notaries, May, 1887; mem. of the exec. coun., May, 1881; atty.-gen. and premier, May, 1881, to June, 1882; col. sec. and prem., July, 1882, to May, 1884; proceeded to England to negotiate loan for pub. wks., Oct., 1883; as priv. mem., carried through the Executors and Trustees Accounts Act, 1873; Titles Registration and Derelict Lands Act, 1881; prepared and carried during term of office, General Loans Act, 1881; Postal Act, 1882; Lands Clauses Act, 1882; Municipal Act, 1882; Police Regulation Act, 1882; Aliens' Naturalisation Act, 1883; Public Health Act, 1883; Liquor Licensing Act, 1883; leg. adviser, Rhodesia, 1894; legal adviser, Rhodesia Administrative Staff, 1895.



SCHOOLEFIELD, WILFRED JOCELYN STUART.—Bechuanaland Border pol., Jan., 1891; line mak. Bechuanaland rly. construction, 1st Feb., 1896; res. mag., Ngamiland, 22nd Jan., 1897; nativ. comsnr., N.W. Transvaal, 22nd June, 1897.

served in Matabele campaign, 1893; Matabele rebellion, 1896; S. Africa, siege of Mafeking, etc.; A.D.C. to Lieut.-Gen. Lord Methuen, etc.; comdt., North Prot., and lines of communication, 1st Mar., 1902; mentioned in despatches; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 23rd June, 1906.



SCHOLZITZ, CLERKE BURTON.—Comanr., Lichtenburg, Transvaal, 1877; lieut., Bechuana-land field force on Sir C. Warren's staff; mem. of comnr. on Stellaland claims, 1885; ch. clk. and asst. mag., Vrijburg, 1885; R.M., Kuruman, 1889.



SCHOMBURGK, OTTO HEINRICH.—Cik., engnr.-in-chief's office, S. Aust., Jan., 1874; clk., ch. sec.'s office, Aug., 1877; clk., regar.-gen. of deeds office, July, 1880; clk., sheriff's office, Nov., 1882; dep. sheriff, 1891; also returning offr. W. Adelaide, Jan., 1893, to June, 1902; sheriff, July, 1903; also Commonwealth electoral offr., for the state of S. Aust., Aug., 1903; major, comdg. field batt. of artillery (retired).



SCHOOLES, SIR HENRY RAWLINS PIPON, K.T., BACH. (1905).—B. 1850; ed. Marlborough; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., Hilary, 1873; admitted to bar, Leeward Is., May, 1873; mem. for Sandy Point legis. assem. of St. Kitts, Mar., 1874, to Apr., 1876; ag. atty.-gen., Leeward Is., Apr. to Sept., 1876; re-elected mem. for Sandy Point, Jan., 1877; mem. of new legis. coun. of St. Kitts, 1879, and elected by the legis. coun. as sen. mem. for St. Kitts of fed. coun. of the Lee-ward Is.; June, 1880, atty.-gen., Br. Honduras; June, 1881, apptd. provisionally as ch. just. of Br. Honduras; atty.-gen., Grenada, Apr., 1883; ditto, Jamaica, 1896; ch. just., Gibraltar, 1905.



SCHREIBER, COLLINGWOOD, C.M.G. (1893).—B. 1831; emigrated from England, 1852; entered service of Hamilton and Toronto Rly., and became asst. engnr., 1852; suptdng. engnr. of wks., N. Rly. of Canada, 1860-64; div. engnr., Nova Scotia govt. service, on Truro and Pictou Rly., 1864-5; survey engnr., Dominion govt. service, on inter-col. rly., 1886; suptdng. engnr., N. Brunswick E. Rly., 1869-75; ditto, inter-col. railway, 1871-3; ch. engnr. of govt. railways in operation, 1873-8; also gen. man., 1878-80; also engnr.-in-chief, Canadian Pacific Rly., 1880; now engnr.-in-chief, govt. rlys. and dep. min. of rlys. and canals.



SCHREINER, THE HON. W. P., C.M.G. (1890), K.C.—B. 1857; ed. S. A. Coll., Capetown, Camb. Univ., and London; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape, 1882; legal adviser to high comnr., 1887-93; atty.-gen. in Mr. Rhodes's ministry, 1893; mem. of Jameson Raid Comte., premier and col. sec., 1898-1900.



SCOFFHAM, W. H.—B. 1883; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to census office, 20th Feb., 1901; transf. to C.O., 17th Dec., 1902.



SCONCE, HERBERT W.—Ed. at Hurst Coll., Sussex; Gran. Schl.; Bristol; Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. math. tripos, 1886; M.A. 1897; asst. master, Faversham Gram. Schl.; Godolphin Schl., Hammersmith, and Grocers' Co.'s Coll., Hackney, 1887 to 1893; asst. mr., Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1893; asst. inspr. of schls., July, 1895; ag. inspr., May to Nov., 1898; June to Nov., 1900; July, 1902, to Apr., 1903; inspr. of schls. and offl. visitor of Onderneeming Indust. Schl., Apr., 1903; mem. bd. of agric. for educat. matters; examr. for prelim. exam. for govt. clerical serv.



SCOTT, J. H.—Mag., Tembuland, Aug., 1876; capt. in Tembu levies, Sept., 1877; ag. ch. mag., Tembuland, Apr. to July, 1878; ch. clk., native affairs dept., Oct., 1878; sec. to atty.-gen., on special duty to N. Border during war there, Feb., to Apr., 1879; ag. special comanr., N. Border, May to July, 1879; special comanr. and special mag. of N. Border, July, 1879; res. comanr., Pondoland, July, 1888.



SCOTT, RALPH.—B. 1874; B.A. Lond. Univ.; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1895; ag. collr. of land rev., Singapore, Mar., 1897; passed final exam. in Malay, Sept., 1897; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, Sept., 1897; confirmed, Aug., 1898; apptd. to Cls. IV., Jan., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, Apr., 1903; attached to land off., Sing., on spec. duty, July, 1905; ag. collr. of land rev., Singapore, Jan., 1906; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, Mar., 1906; ag. comanr. of ct. of requests, Singapore, July, 1906, to Feb., 1907; dist. offr., Dindings, Aug., 1906; collr. of land rev., Penang, Feb., 1907.



SCOTT, THE HON. RICHARD WILLIAM, K.C.—Called to the bar of Upper Canada, 1884; created a Q.C., 1867; sat in the legis. assem. of Canada from 1867 to 1873, and while there carried the Separate School Act of Upper Canada; returned to the Ontario assem. at confedn., 1867; ret. on his entrance into the Dominion Govt., Nov., 1873; called to the senate, Mar., 1874; was speaker of the Ontario assem. from 7th to 21st Dec., 1871; mem. of exec. coun. and comanr. of crown lands for same prov., from later date until Nov., 1873, when sworn of the Queen's privy coun.; S. of S. of Canada, Jan., 1874; ret. on resignation of Mackenzie govt., Oct., 1878; is now a senator; was the framer of the Canada Temperance Act, known as the Scott Act; joined Sir W. Laurier's govt. as S. of S., June, 1896.



SCOTT, ROBT.—B. 1873; acctnt. to director, army telegraphs, O.R.C., July, 1900; asst. acctnt., dept. of posts and telegraphs, Aug., 1902.



SCOTT, WALTER.—B. 1862; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., 22nd Jan., 1883; promoted to higher grade, 2nd div., 3rd Nov., 1896.



SCROGGES, LIEUT. HAROLD CHAS., R.N.—Harbour mast. and supt. of merc. marine, Mauritius, 23rd June, 1903.



SCRUBY, CHARLES BURDETT, B.A.—B. 1876; ed. priv. and Sidney Sussex Coll., Camb., and in France; asst. collr., Br. Cent. Africa Prot., 1899; ag. vice-consul, Fort Johnston, 1901; dist. comanr., Lagos, 1902; ag. collr. of cust., 1904; asst. to comanr. for Egba bdry. delimitation, 1904-5; certif. from schl. of mil. engnrg., Chatham, in mil. topography and astronomy, 1905; passed Yoruba exam., 1906.



SEALY, A.—Pol. mag. of dist. B, Barbados, Sept., 1873.



SEALY, FRANK DEAN.—Supernum. clk., immigr. dept., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1884; 4th class clk., Apr., 1891; 3rd class, Jan., 1894; 2nd class, Apr., 1895; immigr. agt., Oct., 1898.



SEALY, GORDON COURLAND MILLER.—B. 1863; clk. to the atty.-gen., Tobago, Jan., 1882; clk. in col. sec.'s dept., 1883; acted as confill. clk. to the admstr. and clk. of couns., 1883 to 1886; 3rd clk., surg.-gen.'s dept., Br. Guiana, 1887; 2nd clk., 1887; has acted as ch. clk.; 4th class clk., treasv. dept., 1st June, 1901; 3rd class clk., ditto, 14th May, 1906.



SEALY, J. ERNEST CAMERON.—2nd clk., audit and registry dept., Tobago, Feb., 1888; clk. to comanrs. and financial bd., Nov., 1890, and Oct., 1893; sec. to bd. of educn., Sept., 1892; ch. clk. treasv., June, 1893; postmnr. of Tobago, Dec., 1895.



SEARCY, ARTHUR.—Boarding offr., cust., S. Aust., 1873; clk., cust., 1874; clk., audit offr., 1875; clk., cust., 1876; tide inspr. and measur.

of ships, cust., 1889; correspdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1890; ag. dep. comsnr. of taxes and stamps, 1891; correspdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1891; sec., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1891; clk. astt. and sergeant-at-arms, H. of A., 1894; comsnr. of taxes and dep. comsnr. of taxes and stamps, Oct., 1897; also pres., marine bd., 1902; also inspr. of kerosene, 1902; also comsnr. of trade marks and regsr. of copyrights, 1904-7.



SEATON, G. L.—B. 1860; apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. mess., C.O., 17th May, 1899; 2nd cl., 18th Feb., 1900; King's mess., 10th June, 1904.



SECCOMBE, GEORGE SAMUEL, L.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), 1874—B. 1852; mem. Medico-Psychological Assoc.; sec. astt. med. offr. and dep. med. supt. of Caterham Asylum, England, 1874; med. supt. of lun. asyl., and med. offr., roy. gaol, Trinidad, Sept., 1882.



SEDGEWICK, ROBERT, K.C.—Dep. min. of just. and solr. of Indian affairs, Canada, 1888; now a puisne judge, sup. ct.



SEIGNORET, CLARENCE AUGUSTUS.—B. 1867; supernumerary treas., Dominica, 1890; sec. to special yaws comsn., Mar., 1891, to Sept., 1892; ch. clk., registr.'s office and elk. pub. market, 1892; astt. sec. to Sir R. Hamilton during his inquiry in Dominica, 1893; govt. offr., treasy., 1895; sec. bd. of health and quarantine, 1895; ag. clk., admstr.'s office and exec. coun., 1895; ag. treas., Dominica, July, 1901; harbrmr., 1906; survr. of shipping, 1907.



SEIGNORET, G. B.—Clk. to postmr., Dominica, 1889; govt. offr., treasy., 1893; ch. clk., registr.'s offr., 1895; ag. postmr., 1896-7; clk. govt. offr., Roseau, 1897; govt. offr., treasy., 1901.



SELBORNE, 2nd EARL OF (creat. 1882), VISCOUNT WOLMER, BARON SELBORNE (U.K.), P.C. (1900), G.C.M.G. (1905), THE RT. HON. WM. WALDEGRAVE PALMER.—B. 1859; ed. at Winchester and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. (1st cls. hist.), 1882; astt. priv. sec. to Mr. Childers, Chanc. of Excheq., 1882-86; was mem. of parlmt. for E. Hunts, 1885-92, and for W. Edinburgh City, 1892-95; succeeded his father, 1895; Under S. of S. forCols., June, 1895; chmn., Pacific cable comtce., 1896; mem. of Pacific cable comtce., 1899; first lord of the admiralty, Nov. 12th, 1900; high comsnr. for S. Africa, and gov. and comdr.-in-chief of Transvaal and O.R.C., 15th Mar., 1905; ceased to be gov. of O.R.C. on grant of resp. govt., June, 1907.



SELBY-LOWNDES, R. C. W.—Ed. at I. of Wight Coll. and Tanworth Coll.; served in B.S.A. pol. during Mashonaland rebellion, 1896-7; chartered company's civil serv., 1898-1900; served during S. Africa war, Rhodesia regt., Rhodesian field force, and French's scouts, 1900-1902 (medals, Mashonaland, 1897, Queen's medal, S. A. war, 4 clasps, King's medal, 2 clasps).



SELLS, H. C., B.A. (Oxon).—Cadet, S. Sttlmts., Oct., 1897; ag. priv. sec. to gov., Nov., 1898, to Nov., 1899; ag. 4th mag., Singapore, Jan., 1900; passed fin. exam. in Malay, Apr., 1900; ag. dist. offr., prov. Well., May, 1901; supt., money order branch and govt. savings bank, Sing., May, 1902; head of Malay coll., Malacca, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., Nibong Tebal, Apr., 1905; ag. astt. postmr.-gen., Penang, Nov., 1906; confirmed, May, 1907.



SEMFER, D. H.—Clk. to atty.-gen., Leeward Islands, 1893; dep. coroner for dist. B., Oct., 1898; ag. Federal treas., Oct., 1902; fed. treas., Mar., 1903; acted as clk., leg. coun., Antigua, Dec., 1902; ditto, ex. coun., Montserrat, Mar., 1903; ag. ch. regsr., Leeward Is., and regsr. and prov. marshal, admstr. of estates, offl. recvr. in bank., regsr. of titles, regsr. of friendly societies, and regsr.-gen. of births, deaths and marriages, Antigua, Feb. to July, 1905; apptd. regsr. and prov.-marshal, admstr. of estates, offl. recvr. in bank., and regsr. of titles, St. Kitts-Nevis, July, 1905; J.P., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1905.



SENEVIRATNE, ALEXANDER DE ALVIS.—Mem. of legis. coun., Ceylon; advoc. of the sup. ct.; mem. mun. coun., Colombo, and coun. of legal educn.; chmn. Ceylon national assoc.



SENIOR, BERNARD, I.S.O. (1906).—B. 1865; clk. to the bindry. comsn. (Redistribution of Seats Act, 1884) attached to Scotch educn. dept., 1885, and again 1888; priv. sec. to Sir F. R. Sandford, under-secr. for Scotland, 1887; 1st class clk., col. sec.'s office, G. Const., 1889; local auditor, Lagos, Aug., 1889; ditto, G. Coast, Dec., 1889; ditto, Br. Bechuanaland, Feb., 1894; ditto, Cyprus, 1895; aud.-gen., O.R.C., Sept., 1902; is also chmn. of tender bd.; mem. of comsn. to inquire into law relating to mining for diamonds and precious stones in O.R.C., 1895; ag. col. treas., 12th Aug., 1903, to 16th Feb., 1904; M.L.C., May, 1904; deleg. for O.R.C. at S. African freights confce., 1904-5; mem. of O.R.C. civ. ser. comsn., 1905; chmn. of govt. tender bd.; dir. of National Bank of O.R.C.; col. auditor, Ceylon, 1st Mar., 1907; author of "A Guide to the examination of Government Accounts in Cyprus."



SETH, ARATHOON, I.S.O. (1905).—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1893; Hindustani interp., magistracy, Hong Kong, Feb., 1898, to Dec., 1899 (in the serv. of the P. & O. Co. in the interim); re-entered magistracy as 3rd clk., Sept., 1872; 2nd clk., Sept., 1873; 1st clk., Feb., 1875; clk. of couns., and ch. clk., C.S.O., Feb., 1881; valuer under the "Rating Ord.", 1875, 25th June, 1881, to 19th Mar., 1883; J.P., Jan., 1882; sup. of the opium revenue, Aug., 1883, to Feb., 1885; ditto, imports and exports, June to Oct., 1887; sec. to bd. under "Taipingshan resumption order," 1894-1895 (reed. thanks of govt.), sec. to insatiable property comsn., July, 1896; ag. deputy land offr., Nov., 1894, to Jan., 1895; ditto, Mar., 1895, to Nov., 1896; dep. regsr. and appraiser, sup. ct., and comsnr. for oaths, Mar., 1895; comsnr. for taking acknowledgments of married women, Oct., 1896; sec. squatter's bd.; offl. recvr. in bankruptcy, Mar., 1895, to Nov., 1896; ag. astt. regsr.-gen., July to Sept., 1897; ag. regsr., sup. ct.; ag. land offr.; ag. regsr. of companies; offl. admstr., and offl. trustee, 15th Dec., 1898, to 28th Jan., 1900; mem. bd. examrs., 1902; ag. regsr., sup. ct., offl. admstr., offl. trustee and regsr. of companies, 1903-04; confirmed, 1904.



SETH, G. G.—B.A., Calcutta; cadet, S. S., Nov., 1901; ag. sheriff, Singapore, Jan., 1903; passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1903; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 5th Jan., 1904; ag. dep. regsr., sup. ct., Singapore, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., N. Tebal, June, 1906; ag. dep. regsr.-sup. ct., Penang, Sept., 1906; astt. to atty.-gen., Apr., 1907.



SHAND, CHAS. ARTHUR.—Mem. local assembly, Antigua, 1876-1891; ditto, federal coun., 1877-1891; J.P., Antigua, 1885; mem. ex. coun., Antigua, 1887; chmn. P.L. guardians and of several local boards, Antigua; dist. mag., Nevis, Feb., 1903; and offl. mem. leg. coun., St. Kitts-Nevis; mem. exec. coun., St. Kitts-Nevis, Oct., 1904; J.P., Nov., 1904.

SHARE, HAMNET HOLDITCH.—B. 1864; entd. R. Navy, 1880; served in H.M.S. "Tourmaline" and numerous other ships (Egypt. medal, 1882, and Khedive's Bronze Star); sec. to comdr.-in-chief, Pacific station, 1899-1900; ditto, Australia station, 1901-1903; priv. sec. to gov. of N. S. Wales, May, 1903; priv. sec. to gov.-gen. of Australia, 22nd Nov., 1904.



SHARPE, SIR ALFRED, K.C.M.G. (1903), C.B. (1897).—B. 1853; H.M.'s vice-consul, Nyasaland, 14th Feb., 1891; ditto, for territories under British influence North of the Zambesi, 18th Feb., 1893; consul for same territories, 1st Feb., 1894; ag. consnr. and consul-gen. at Zomba, 7th May, 1894, to 3rd May, 1895; given rank of deputy consnr., 1st Apr., 1896; and again acted as consnr. and consul-gen., 16th Apr., 1896, to 14th July, 1897; consnr. and consul-gen., for territories under Brit. infl. N. of Zambesi, 15th July, 1897; recd. Jubilee medal, 1897; consnr., commdr-in-chief, and consul-gen., Br. Cent. Africa Prot., 1st Jan., 1902; recd. Coronation medal, 1902; gov. of Nyasaland (late B.C.A. Prot.), 6th Sept., 1907.



SHARPE, W. S., C.M.G. (1900).—B. 1860; capt. 4th batt. R.I. Rifles, 1893; major, Oct., 1903; inspr., Sierra Leone frontier force, Mar., 1894; 3rd consnr. to Anglo-French bdry. consnr. and delimited frontier from Atlantic coast to Little Mora River, 1896; dist. consnr., Karene dist., Jan., 1897; F.R.G.S., and J.P. for the col.; transf'd to N. Nigeria as asst. res., Dec., 1900; apptd. 2nd class res., Oct., 1901.



SHAW, CHARLES COURTENAY.—B. 1878; clk. in off. of sec. to Transvaal adminstrn., Mar., 1901; ag. priv. sec. to ditto, Mar. to June, 1902; priv. sec. to col. sec., Transvaal, July, 1902; ag. sec., Transvaal immigr., off., May, 1904, to June, 1906; J.P., Witwatersrand, May, 1906; priv. sec. to lieut.-gov., O.R.C., 1st July, 1906; priv. sec. to gov., O.R.C., July, 1907.



SHAWE, HENRY BENJAMIN.—Clt. at Clanwilliam, Cape Colony, 12th May, 1883; col. secy.'s off., Cape Town, Dec., 1883; sen. examnr. of acctns., 14th Apr., 1890; chief distt., 1st July, 1894; acctnt., 10th July, 1895; acctng. offr., 31st Mar., 1899; ch. clk. and acctng. offr., 1st Mar., 1901; ag. under col. sec., 1st Apr. to 30th Sept., 1901; asst. under col. sec., 1st Apr., 1902.



SHEA, THE HON. SIR E. D., KT. BACH. (1902).—Col. sec. and clk. of coun., Newfoundland, Jan., 1874; cashier of savings bank, and pres. of legis. coun., Feb., 1886.



SHEA, THE HON. GEORGE.—M.H.A., Ferryland (Newfild.), 1889-93; again in 1897; mem. exec. coun. (without portfolio), 1897; mem. of treasy. bd., 1898; mayor of St. John's, 1902; mem. exec. coun., 1904.



SHENTON, THE HON. SIR GEORGE, KT. BACH. (1893), J.P.—B. 1842; mem. of the legislature of W. Australia, 1870-74, 1875-90; on the introduction of respon. govt.; col. sec. in the first ministry formed by Sir John Forrest; pres. of the legis. coun., 1892-1901; is senior mem. of the metropolitan prov.; has been mayor of Perth on eleven different occasions.



SHEPPARD, WALTER SYDNEY, B.A., M.B., B. Ch., Cantab.—B. 1871; civil surg. in charge of H.M.'s troops, N.E. dist., Eng., May, 1898, to May, 1899; spec. plague med. offr., India, May, 1899, to Nov., 1900; house surg., gen. hosp., Singapore, 19th Nov., 1900; super. col. surg., S. Stthtns., 1st Mar., 1901; spec. mission to Brunei, Aug., 1904; col. surg., Prov. Wellesley, Aug., 1905.



SHEPSTONE, ARTHUR JESSE, C.M.G. (1902), J.P. (Natal).—Asst. consnr. and res. mag., Lower Umtolosi dist., Natal, 21st June, 1887; mag., Nkandhla dist., 28th Feb., 1891; Emtonjaneni dist., 1st Dec., 1894; Vryheid, 27th Jan., 1903; Newcastle, 21st Nov., 1904.



SHEPSTONE, H. C., C.M.G. (1895).—B. 1840; priv. sec. to the lieut.-gov., Natal, 1867; clk. to exec. coun., 1863; Indian immigr. agt. and J.P., 1864; R.M. and admstr. of native law, Alfred co., 1870; ditto, Durban co., 1878; acted as sec. to Mr. Justice Phillips, C.M.G., on special service to Barbados, 1876; served on the staff of Sir Theophilus Shepstone, K.C.M.G., H.M.'s special consnr. in S. Africa, 1877; sec. for native affairs, Transvaal, July, 1877; attended Cetywayo on his visit to England, 1882; sec. for native affairs, Natal, 1884; ret., 1883.



SHEPSTONE, JOHN WESLEY, C.M.G. (1888).—B. 1827; July, 1846, govt. interp., Natal; July, 1847, accompanied Capt. Kyle on special mission to Zulu king; Dec., 1850, accompanied Capt. Gordon on special mission to Pondos; Oct., 1851, interp. to recorder and mag.'s offices; Dec., 1851, asst. R.M., Pietermaritzburg co.; Aug., 1852, R.M., Lower Umtoti, and govt. agt., Noniti country, and J.P.; 1857, commanded native forces against Chief Usidio and tribe, and against Chief Matyana and tribe; Nov., 1858, supt. of the cultivation of cotton; Apr., 1861, ag. sec. for native affairs and judicial assessor; July, 1861, commanded a native force in the Fort Buckingham expedit.; May, 1862, ag. R.M., Inanda div.; Aug., 1863, asst. R.M., Pietermaritzburg co.; ag. R.M., Umtoti co., Sept., 1867; May, 1874, consnr., Klip River and Weenen counties; July, 1874, ag. sec. for native affairs and judicial assessor; Oct., 1874, J.P. for the col.; Sept., 1876, sec. for native affairs and mem. exec. and legis. couns.; Mar., 1878, mem. of the bdry. consnr.; Dec., 1878, delivered ultimatum to Zulu deleg. at Lower Drift Tugela; Aug., 1879, accompanied Sir Garnet Wolseley to arrange the settlement of Zululand; mentioned in despatches; Dec., 1882, Br. consnr., Zululand; Jan., 1884, judge, native high ct.; ret., 1896.



SHERIFF, PERCY MUSGRAVE CRESSWELL.—B. 1869; called to the bar, Mid. Temple, June, 1892; admitted to the bar of B. Hond., 1893; of Jamaica, 1895; ag. dist. consnr., Belize, for six months in 1898; apptd. mag. and coroner, So. dist., Grenada, 1900; visiting just. of prisons, 1900; chairman of St. George's Road Board, 1901; ag. mem. legis. coun., June, 1902; ag. ch. just., St. Vincent, Dec., 1902, to Dec., 1903, when confirmed; admtd. govt., and ag. col. sec. and treas., Aug., 1903; mem. bd. of educn.; prov. mem. of exec. coun., and legal adviser to admstr., and draughtsman of govt. bills, Dec., 1902, to Apr., 1906; M.L.C., 1904; ch. just., St. Lucia, 1906; compiled "Comparative Index of Laws of Grenada and St. Vincent," Dec., 1905; and "Index of Laws of St. Lucia," Dec., 1907.



SHIPWAY, WALTER ROBERT.—B. 1879; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd div. clk., and assigned to C.O., Dec., 1898.



SHOHLA, LIONEL HENRY, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1844; clk., P.W. office, S. Australia, July, 1858; clk., waterworks dept., Jan., 1859; clk., audit office, Sept., 1863; ch. clk., Jan., 1872; ch. clk. and acctnt., treasy., July, 1874; acctnt. and receiver of rev., treasy., July, 1876; cashier and acctnt., treasy., July, 1879; under-treas., July, 1883; under-sec. and govt. statist., May, 1890; also clk. of exec. coun., July, 1894.

SHORT, EDWARD AWDRY.—Ed. at Clifton, and Cent. Tech. Coll., London; ch. engrn., dept. of posts and telegraphs, O.R.C., 9th May, 1904.



SHORT, EDWARD MORRISON DE COUCY.—B. 1857; Ceylon writer, 1878; pol. mag., 1883; ag. dist. judge, Chilaw, 1884; ag. asst. govt. agt., Kalutara, 1886; ditto, Mannar, Jan., 1889; ditto, Hambantota, Sept., 1889; ditto, Kegalla, 1890; ditto, Varuniya and Mullaithivu, 1890; ditto, Kalutara, 1893; ditto, Matara, 1894; ditto, Chilaw, 1895; ditto, Varuniya, 1896; asst. govt. agt., Matale, Oct., 1896; ditto, Matara, 1897; ditto, Matale, 1900; ditto, Nuwara Eliya, 1900; ag. govt. agt., Badulla, 1903; ditto, N.W. Prov., 1904; chrmn. of mun. coun. and mayor of Colombo, 1905.



SHOWERS, EDWARD MELIAN.—Served in Bengal police, Feb., 1867, to Sept., 1901; comsnr. of pol., Transvaal, 8th Nov., 1901.



SIDNEY, T. S., M.A.—Ed. Harvard, and Trin. Hall, Camb.; called to the bar, Mid. Term., June, 1885; enrolled adv. to high ct. of Madras, 1894; apptd. dist. comsnr., Epe, Lagos, Jan., 1901.



SIERRA LEONE, BISHOP OF, RT. REV. EDMUND HENRY ELWIN, M.A., Merton Coll., Oxon; cur. of St. Peter-le-Bailey, Oxford, 1894-6; chaplain at Fourah Bay Coll., S. Leone, 1896-8; principal, 1898-1901; chapln. to Bp. of S. Leone, 1898-1901; Bishop of Sierra Leone, 1901.



SILBERRAD, HUBERT.—Ed. at Wren's and Finishing Tech. Coll. (engineering); asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 8th May, 1903.



SIMPSON, GEORGE.—Inspr. of schls., Bermuda, 1880; also inspir. of dockyard schls.



SIMPSON, SAMUEL.—B. 1876; ed. at Owen's Coll., and Edin. Univ.; B.Sc.; Stevens scholar; sec. to the Union; sen. pres. of students representative coun.; Highland and agric. soc'y. s prizeman; life mem. and silver medallist of roy. agric. soc'y.; holder of nat. diploma in agric.; sen. lecturer in agric. to Govt. Agric. Coll., Ghizeh, Egypt; cotton expert to B.C.A. Prot., Mar., 1905; author of "Report on Cotton Growing Industry in B.C.A. Prot."



SINCKLER, EDWARD GOULBERT.—B. 1856; entered col. sec.'s office, Barbados, Nov., 1874; acted as clk. to lieut.-gov., 1878; 2nd clk. corrprude. branch, col. sec.'s office, 1879; ag. asst. clk. to Gov. W. Robinson, 1880; 1st clk. record branch, col. sec.'s office, and clk., courts of ordinary and error, Jan., 1883; ag. ch. clk., 1886; comsnr. of census, 1891; ch. clk. to judges, asst. ct. of appeal, 1892; J.P., Oct., 1892; ag. registr., friendly socs., June, 1893; ag. sen. pol. mag., Bridgetown, and dist. A, Aug. to Oct., 1893; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. B, Sept. to Oct., 1894; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. F, July, 1896, to Jan., 1897; ag. pol. mag., judge, and coroner, dist. B, Sept. to Oct., 1897; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. D, Mar. to Apr., 1898; ag. coroner, St. Michael, 1898 (at time of hurricane), and has repeatedly acted as such; ag. pol. mag. and judge, dist. B, 1899; ag. pol. mag., dist. A, Feb., 1900; ag. comsnr. of probate, May to Nov., 1900; ag. pol. mag., dist. A, July, 1900, to Sept., 1901; pol. mag. and judge, dist. E, Oct., 1901; discharged duties of pol. mag. and judge, dist. D, in addition to own duties, Sept., 1905; and from Aug. to Oct., 1907; ag. pol. mag., dist. A, 18th July to 23rd Nov., 1906; coroner, dist. E, 27th May, 1907; suggested Nelson centenary postage stamp, 1904; took active part in promotion of celebration of tercentenary of Barbados, 1905.



SINCLAIR, WM.—B. 1844; clk., stores dept. L. and N.W. rly., Jan., 1863; stores auditor, July, 1875; rly. storekeeper, Midland system, Cape govt. rlys., Aug., 1878; ch. rly. storekeeper, Jan., 1886; mem. of tender bd., July, 1901; ch. rly. storekeeper, C.S.A.R., Dec., 1903; supt. of stores and shipping branch, Transvaal agt.'s office, London, July, 1907.



SINGAPORE, LABUAN, AND SARAWAK.



3RD BISHOP OF LABUAN, THE RIGHT REV. GEORGE FREDERICK HOSE, D.D.—Ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1861; M.A., 1867; D.D., 1881; curate of Roxton with Great Barford, Beds, 1861-45; curate of Trinity, St. Marylebone, London, 1865-67; col. chaplain, Malacca, Nov., 1867; ditto Singapore, Feb., 1874; regis. of the diocese of Labuan, Apr., 1874; archdeacon of Singapore, Dec., 1874; bishop of Singapore, Labuan and Sarawak 1881.



SIVEWRIGHT, THE HON. SIR JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1892), C.M.G. (1880).—B. 1848; gen. man. of telegraphy, C. of Good Hope, Apr., 1878; ret., 1885; M.L.A., 1889; mem. of Rhodes's ministry without portfolio, July, 1900, and subsequently as comn. of crown lands and pub. wks.; resig., 1885; resumed office, Jan., 1896.



SKEETE, ELLIOT L., B.A., Durham, 1888.—Asst. to supt. bot. station, Barbados, Sept., 1890; ag. supt., Dec., 1890, to Jan., 1891; ch. off. reformatory, May, 1892; ag. supt. reformatory and bot. station, July to Dec., 1894, and Apr. to May, 1895, and since 1899.



SKENE, RALPH RANGABE FELIX HENRY.—Ed. at St. Paul's schl., London, and Calvin's Coll., Geneva; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 5th Dec. 1897; collr., 1st Apr., 1903.



SKERRETT, CHRISTOPHER MARTIN.—B. 1864; supernumerary clk., registr. and provost marshal's office, Dominica, July to Dec., 1891, and Feb. to Sept., 1892; asst. clk. to govt. offr., Roseau, Sept., 1892, to Mar., 1893; aid waiter, treas., Aug. to Oct., 1893; tax collr., treas., Nov., 1893, to Apr. 1894; asst. clk., tax dept., treas., 1895; asst. to admstr., Jan. to Mar., 1896; 2nd clk., registr. and prov. marshal's off., Dominica, Mar., 1898, to Dec. 1899; 1st clk., Jan., 1901; is a comsnr. to adminstr. oaths, Dominica, and supt. of pub. cemeteries; ag. registr. and prov. marshal, June and July, 1901, and in Jan., 1905; has held numerous "acting" appointments.



SKINNER, WM.—Ed. Belford Gram. Schl.; open scholar, St. Catherine's Coll., Camb., B.A. (math. tripos), June, 1882, and bracketed int. sen. optime; M.A., Oct., 1886; headmnr., gram. schl., Dominica, 1st Jan., 1883; J.P. and visiting just., Roseau prison, Dec., 1895; nom. mem. of Roseau town bd., 1899; sub-inspr. of schls., Dominica, 12th June, 1901; inspr. of weights and measures, Dominica, 1st Feb., 1902; ag. inspr. of schls., Leeward Islands, June to Nov., 1903; ag. treas., Dominica, Dec., 1903; chmn. of Roseau town bd., May to Dec., 1904; ag. inspr. of schls., Leeward Islands, Sept., 1905; offr. in charge of prison discipline, Nov., 1905.



SKIRVING, JOHN MACKENZIE.—B. 1874; ed. at George Watson's Coll., Edin.; served nine years in 91st Highlanders; on Boer prisoners of war staff, St. Helena, Nov., 1899 to Oct., 1902; inspr. of pol. gaoler and mag.'s clk., St. Helena, Mar., 1903; also sanitary inspr., firemaster and inspr. of weights and measures, 1906.



SLADER, C. H. YORKE.—Jun. clk., treas., Jamaica, 1883; sen. asst. clk. cts., Clarendon, 1889; dep. clk. cts., Westmoreland, 1892; 1st cls. clk., sup. cts., 1894; ag. registr., 1895; headmnr.

Jamaica militia, 1895; offr. with Jubilee contingent (medal), 1897; ag. registr., 1898; capt., 1899; passed exam. before judges of sup. ct. equal to solrs. final, 1899; clk. of cts., Clarendon, 1900; joined hon. socy. Grays' Inn, 1904; passed final, 1905; ag. comsnr. and judge of grand court, Cayman Islands, 1906.



SLATER, ALEXANDER RANSFORD.—B. 1874; ed. at King Ed. schl., Birmingham, and Emm. Coll., Camb. (B.A. 1897); cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1898; extra off. asst. govt. agent, W. P., Aug., 1899; 2nd asst., P.M.G., Mar., 1900; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., Dec., 1901; on spec. duty at camp for prisoners of war Dyalatawa, July, 1902; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., Jan., 1903; clk. legis. coun., May, 1904; dist. judge, Badulla, Apr., 1906; additional asst. col. sec. and clk., legis. couns., Apr., 1907.



SLOLEY, HERBERT CECIL, C.M.G. (1905).—Served in C.M.R. in campaigns against Griquas and Moirosi (medal with clasp, 1877-8-9); capt. in native contingent, Basuto war, 1880-1; mentioned in despatches; sub-inspr., Cape police, 1883; ditto, Basutoland, 1884; inspr., 1886; asst. comsnr., Basutoland, 1889; ag. res. comsnr., July to Dec., 1895; govt. sec., 1898; ag. res. comsnr., Dec., 1900; res. comsnr., Sept., 1901.



SLYNE, D.—Barrister-at-law; Lord O'Hagan medallist and David Lynch medallist, King's Inns, Ireland; entered Imperial civ. serv., open compet., 1880; until 1900 attached successively to Inland Rev. Dept. at Dublin, Sligo, Chester, Oxford, Leicester, Birmingham, Dublin, Dundee, and Birmingham; apptd. supervising excise offr., Trinidad, 1900; ag. receiver-gen., May, 1902; receiver-gen., Feb., 1903.



SMALL, ROBERT.—Ed. at Univ. Coll. Schl., St. Thomas Hosp., King's Coll. Hosp., and Univ. Coll. Hosp.; certif. of Lond. Schl. of Trop. Med.; L.R.C.P. (Lond.); M.R.C.S. (Eng.), 1901; D.P.H. (Lond.), 1905; D.T.C. (Camb.), 1906; civ. surg., S. African field force, 1901-1902; med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prota., 16th Feb., 1906.



SMALLWOOD, HENRY ARMSTRONG.—Entered navy, 1885; on board H.M.S. "Victoria" at time of disaster, June, 1893; asst. comsnr., Colo West, and stip. mag., Apr., 1894; ag. stip. mag., Ba and Yasawa, Apr., 1896; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, and priv. sec. to gov. Fiji, Apr., 1896; ag. sec. to W. Pac. high comsnr., May, 1897, to May, 1898; stip. mag., Savu Savu and Tavuni, Jan., 1899; island treas., Cyprus, Mar., 1900; passed lower standard Greek, Dec., 1900; ag. comsnr., Nicosta, June-Sept., 1904; treas., St. Lucia, 1907.



SMART, ARCHIBALD WM.—B. 1849; clk., dept. of trade and cust., Melbourne, 1863; landing waiter, 1868; landing survr., 1890; senior ditto, 1893; collr. of cust., Victoria, and regist. of shipping, Melbourne, 1903; also ch. Commonwealth survr., 1903.



SMARTT, JAMES A.—Alderman of Brandon, Manitoba, 1882-84; mayor, 1885-87; mem. judicial bd., 1886; mem. of prov. legislature, 1886; min. of pub. wks., 1888; dep. min. of the interior of Canada, Apr., 1897; dept. supt.-gen. of Indian affairs, July, 1897.



SMARTT, MAJOR J. P. (3rd batt. South Lancs. Regt.).—Public wks. and roads dept., G. Coast, 1893-96; local auditor, N. C. Prot. (now S. Nigeria), Oct., 1896; chief asst. treas., Dec., 1901; ag. treas., Dec., 1901, to June, 1902, June to Dec., 1903, Sept., 1904, to Jan., 1905, Feb. to Aug., 1905; apptd. provcl. treas. on amalgtn. with Lagos, 1st May, 1905; ag. financial comsnr., mem. of exec. and legis. couns., Aug., 1906, to Mar., 1907; ag. adjt., G. Coast volrs., May to Nov., 1903; ag. comdt., Oct., 1905, to Mar., 1906; attached for duty with N. C. Prot. force (now S. N. Regt.), May to July, 1897, May and Aug., 1900; served with expedytn. force, Benin territories, Apr. and May, 1899 (ment. in desps., medal and clasp); major comdg. So. Nigeria volrs., July, 1907.



SMARTT, DR. THOS. WM.—L.R.C.S., Ireland, 1878; L.K.Q.C.P.I., 1880; M.L.A. for Wodehouse, Cape Colony, 1894; col. sec., 1898; comsnr. of pub. wks., 1900-02, and from Feb., 1904; ag. prime minister during periods of 1904, 1905 and 1906; attended Impl. confce., 1907; holds Cape Colony general service medal, 1879, with clasp, "Transkei," having served as surg. with P.A.O.C.V.A.; also holds medal and clasp for Kimberley siege, 1899-1900.



SMEETON, S.P., I.S.O. (1905).—B. 1842; extra clk. in office of S. of S. forCols., June, 1862; 1st class clk. in col. sec.'s office, Jamaica, June, 1870; regisr.-gen. of births, deaths and marriages, 8th Feb., 1878; suptd. the taking of census of Jamaica, 1881 and 1891; dep. keeper of records (on amalgamation of registration and record depts.), May, 1899; nom. mem. of comsnr. to inquire into marriage and registn. laws, May, 1903.



SMITH, ALEXANDER.—Treasy. asst., E. Africa Prot., 19th Sept., 1904.



SMITH, ALLAN F., I.S.O. (1906).—Clk. in P.O., Bermuda, 1879; clk., col. sec.'s office, 1886; asst. col. sec., 1895; col. postmtr., 1896; ag. col. sec., July and Aug., 1899, and from May, 1900, to July, 1901.



SMITH, SIR C. ABERCROMBIE KT. BACH. (1903).—M.A. (Camb. and Glas.), fellow of St. Peter's Coll., Camb., 2nd wrangler and 2nd Smith's prize man, 1858, &c.; mem. of the house of assem., Capc., 1866-75; mem. of the exec. coun., 1872; comsnr. of crown lands and pub. works., 1872-75; mem. of comct. under Ordinance 97, 1872-5; comsnr. of the sinking fund, 1872-4; mem. of the Univ. coun., 1873; chmn. of the meteorol. comsn., 1874; comptroller and audr.-gen., 1875; chmn. of the tender bd., 1875; mem. of the surety bd., 1875-86; vice-chancellor, Cape Univ., 1877-9; comsnr., civil ser. exams. bd., 1886; chairman, 1887; ret., 1904.



SMITH, C. A. JEFFREY.—Apprentice, pub. wks. dept., Jamaica, Aug., 1870; asst. to ch. supt., 1875; 3rd class ditto, 1879; 2nd class ditto, 1881; ag. dist. engnr., W. dist., 1886; ditto, Kingston dist., 1888-9; overseer of wks., prisons dept., 1889; 1st cls. supt., pub. wks., and supt., St. Catherine waterwks., 1896; also acted on several occasions as govt. assessor, and supt. irrigation wks.



SMITH, SIR CECIL CLEMENTI, P.C. (1906), G.C.M.G. (1892), K.C.M.G. (1886), C.M.G. (1880).—B. 1844; ed. at St. Paul's Schl. and Corp. Chr. Coll., Camb.; B.A. 1862, M.A. 1868; elected student interp., Hong Kong, Mar., 1862; regsr.-gen., Mar., 1865; ag. pol. mag., June, 1865; ag. col. sec., 1867; mem. of exec. coun., 1869; ag. col. sec., Feb., 1872, to Dec., 1873; treas., 1871; acted as col. sec., Oct., 1874, and also from Mar., 1875; col. sec., S. Sttlments, July, 1878; apptd. under the F.O. to be Br. comsnr. to settle certain marine claims at Manila, Sept., 1878, and received the thanks of H.M.'s govt.; also for services in connection with the "Niseru" case, 1884; administered govt. S.S., Mar., 1884, to Nov., 1885; lieut.-gov. and col. sec., Ceylon, Nov., 1885; gov. of S. S., 1887; also consul-gen. and l.

SMITH, Sir Charles Holled, K.C.M.G., C.B.—B. 1846; ensign, 1863; lieut., 1869; capt., 1877; S. African war, 1879-1881; Zulu campaign; Transvaal cam., battles of Laing's Nek, Ingogo, and Majuba Mountain; despatches, Lon Gaz., May 3rd, 1881; Egypt expdn., 1882; at Ramleh, Tel-el-Mahuta; action at Kasassini; battle of Tel-el-Kebir, Lon Gaz., Nov. 2nd, 1882; major (brevet), Nov., 1882; with Egypt army, Jan., 1883, to Aug., 1892; Soudan expdn., 1884-5; lieut.-col., June, 1885; col., Dec., 1888; gov.-gen., Red Sea littoral, and comdt., Suakim, Sept., 1888, to Aug., 1892; Soudan, 1888-91; action of Gamaizah, Lon Gaz., Jan., 11th, 1889; occupation of Handoul, Jan., 1891; major-gen., coming Victorian mil. forces, Dec., 1894; several medals, clasps to bronze stars, and mentioned in numerous despatches.



SMITH, Edwin Mitchell.—Entered survey, crown lands dept., S Australia, as asst., June, 1862; cadet and jun. surv.; surv., Jan., 1869; draftsman, Jan., 1874; steward and surv. of educn. lands, Feb., 1882; ch. clk., land office, Jan., 1886; dep. surv.-gen., July, 1894; mem. of central pastoral and central lands bd.



SMITH, Francis.—Ch. mag., Gambia, 1879; puisne judge, G. Coast Col., 1887.



SMITH, Francis Jagoe—M.A., Oxon; ed. Merchant Taylors schl.; scholar, St. John's Coll., Oxford, 1892; 2nd cls. class. mods., 1894; 2nd math. mods., 1894; 2nd Lit. Hum., 1896; B.A., 1896; M.A., 1902; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1896; attached to col. sec.'s off., 1896; office asst. to gov't. agt., and deputy fiscal, Cent. Prov., Apr., 1898; comnr. of requests and pol. mag., Balapitiya, Aug., 1900; ditto, Galle, June, 1901; landing surv., customs, Colombo, Dec., 1901; 2nd asst. col. sec., Sept., 1905.



SMITH, The Hon. Sir Francis, Knt (creat. 1862).—B. 1819; B.A., Lond. Univ., 1840; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., May, 1842; solr.-gen., Tasmania, 1840; atty.-gen., 1854; mem. of the legis. assem., 1849-60, and of the exec. comm., 1855-60; atty.-gen. upon the introduction of responsible govt., in 1856; prime min., 1857; raised to the bench as a puisne judge of the sup. ct., 1860; ch. just., May, 1870; was admstr. of the govt., 1874; again, 1880; ret., 1885.



SMITH, Frank Braybrooke—B. 1864; agric. adviser to gov't. of Transvaal, Apr., 1902; dir. of agric., Aug., 1902; M.L.C., 1902-7; and mem. land settlt. bd.



SMITH, Frederick Bonham, L.S.O. (1903).—B. 1837; entered col. sec.'s office, Barbados, 1859; in office of gov., in-chief of the Windward Is., 1860 to 1866; pol. mag. of Christchurch, Barbados, 1866; sen. pol. mag. of Bridgetown and St. Michael, 1873; ag. judge of the ass't. ct. of appeal, 1878 to 1880; inspr. of prisons, 1878, held with office of provost-marshal from 1882; ag. col. sec., 1879.



SMITH, Frederick Stanley.—B. 1870; ed. at Sherborne Coll.; called to the bar, In. Temp., Jan., 1892; ag. pol. mag., dist. "B.", Barbados, 1893; ditto, dist. "D.", Apr., 1894, to July, 1895; and from Dec., 1895, to Oct., 1896; J.P., 1897; ag. judge, ass't. ct. of appeal, Apr. to Sept., 1897; pol. mag., dist. "Y.", Jan., 1899; ag. pol. mag., dist. "A.", Nov., 1901, to Dec., 1902; apptd. pol. mag., dist. "A.", and Bridgetown, Dec., 1902; ag. judge, ass't. ct. of appeal and mast. in chancery in 1906, and again in 1907.



SMITH, George.—B. 1858; entd. war office, 10th Apr., 1878; clk., col. sec.'s office, Cyprus, 24th Nov., 1879; ch. clk., ditto, 1881; ass't. to ch. sec., 13th Dec., 1883; ag. dir. of survey, 10th Aug., 1886, to 14th Feb., 1887; clk., legis. coun., 1st Mar., 1886, to 24th Nov., 1891; ag. sec., and mem. of exec. coun., 15th May, to 10th Oct., 1888, and on other occasions; comdt., Papho, 25th Nov., 1891; regist. gen. and off. mem. of legis. coun., 7th June, 1895; has served also as mem. of comtee. of management, Cyprus museum, 1886; sec., Col. and Ind. Exhib. comtee., 1886; sec. to Queen's Jubilee Memorial comtee., 1887; mem. of land registn. coman., 1891; pres. mun. coman., Papho, 1892; mem. of ecclesiastical com., 1895; mem. of mun. coman., Nicosia, 1895; mem. of gen. hosp. bd., Nicosia, 1896; mem. of bd. of agric., 1896; ag. British delegate of Evcaf, under conven. with Turkey, 20th Nov. to 25th Nov., 1903; ag. prin. forest offr., 1904 and 1907; ag. dir. of agric., 1904 and 1907; British delegate of Evcaf, 20th July, 1905; ag. recr.-gen., and ch. collr. of cust., 1905, 1906 and 1907.



SMITH, George Douglas, C.M.G. (1903).—B. 1865; joined Imperial Brit. East Africa Co., 1890; treas., Uganda Prot., Mar., 1894; East and Cent. African medal with clasp, Uganda, 1897.



SMITH, Capt. George Echlin.—B. 1871; ed. Rathmines Schl. and Trin. Coll., Dublin; joine 5th batt. Royal Irish Regt., 1891; capt., 1896; hon. capt. in army, 1900; asst. inspr., Hans force (G. Coast batt.), Jan., 1897; sub-insp. B. Guiana police, Feb., 1898; dist. inspr., Oct., 1900; A.D.C. to Sir J. A. Swettenham, K.C.M.G., 1902-1904; A.D.C. to Sir F. Hodgson, K.C.M.G., 1904-1906; asst. dist. supt. of police, E. Afr. Prot., Sept., 1906.



SMITH, George Whitfield.—F.L.S., Clk pub. library, Barbados, Sept., 1879; 3rd treas. clk., St. Lucia, 1882; sub-collr. of taxes, 1st dist. St. Lucia, Aug., 1882; rev. offr., Leeward dist. St. Vincent, Feb., 1885 (resigned); curator botanic gardens, Grenada, Dec., 1890, (resigned, 16th Dec., 1893); trav. supt., Imperial dept. of agric., Dec., 1898; pol. mag. and asst. treas. N. dist. Grenada, and pol. mag., 3rd dist. St. Vincent, Apr., 1904; comnr., Carricaug, Oct., 1904; was engaged as asst. botanist to W. India exploration comtee. of Royal Soc. during scientific exploration of St. Vincent, 1888-89; is a corrsp. mem. of Royal Hort. Soc. of England.



SMITH, Gerald Stanley Wells.—B. 1873; graduate, Ontario business coll., Canada; supvr. clk., regist. s'office, Grenada, Jan., 1890; asst. clk., post office, Mar., 1890; 4th clk., treas., June, 1890; asst. clk., col. sec.'s office, Oct., 1890; 2nd clk., treas., Nov., 1891; audt. clk., Nov., 1897; thanked by gov'r, for report on condition of paupers, 1905; has held numerous acting appointments, including ag. aud. of Windward Islands, 4th June to 31st Dec., 1906; and from 1st Jan. to 13th Mar., 1907.



SMITH, Lieut.-Col. Sir Gerard, K.C.M.G. (1895).—B. 1839; late lieut.-col. Roy. Scots Guards; groom-in-waiting to Her Majesty, 1883-5; M.P. for High Wycombe, 1883-5; J.P. for E. Riding of Yorkshire; gov. of W. Australia, 1896 to 1900.

SMITH, HENRY J.—B. 1859; apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. messenger C.O., 12th Nov., 1883; 2nd cl. ditto, 1st June, 1897; Queen's mess., 1st Apr., 1898; asst. office keeper, 22nd May, 1907.



SMITH, JAMES ALFRED—B.1871; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1891; promoted to higher grade, 1902; asst. sec. to col. regns. comtce., 1907-8.



SMITH, JAS. CARMICHAEL.—B. 1852; ch. clk. and storekeeper, Imperial treasy. and commissariat depts., Bahamas, June, 1876, to Aug., 1889; mem. bd. of educ., 1886 to 1892; postmtr., 1889 to 1893; J.P., 1890; elected mem. of Bahamas House of Assembly in 1882-89 and 1896; resigned 1897; asst. postmtr. gen., Sierra Leone, Dec., 1890; J.P., 1897; ag. postmtr.-gen., 1897, 1899, and 1900; ag. curator of intestates, S. L., from Jan., 1899, to Jan., 1900; postmtr.-gen. and man. of govt. sav. bank, 1900; ag. collr. of cust., Oct., 1902, to Apr., 1903; ag. col. treas. in 1906 and 1907; author of "The Distribution of the Produce"; "Inter-Temporary Values, or the Distribution of the Produce in Time"; "The Trust and the Gold Trust."



SMITH, JAMES LANDRETH.—B. 1870; draftsman, P.W.D., St. Lucia, 13th July, 1891; draftsman, survey off., Sept., 1893; warden, and supt. of water-wks. under St. George's town bd., Apr., 1895, to Aug., 1901; chief overseer of roads and works, Grenada, 19th Aug., 1901; asst. supt. of wks., 1st Apr., 1902; comsnr. of crown lands, 28th June, 1904; survr. of crown lands, 1904; ag. supt. of wks., 14th June, 1906, to 16th Jan., 1907.



SMITH, JAMES PARKER, M.P.; P.C.(1904).—Ed. Winchester, and Trin. Coll., Camb. (4th wrangler and 2nd Smith's prizeman, 1877; fellow of Winchester and late fellow Trin. Coll.) called to bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1881; J.P. and D.L., Renfrewshire and co. of city of Glasgow; J.P., Lanarkshire; dir. of Union Bank of Scotland; elected for Partick div. of Lanarkshire, 1890; partly priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, 1901-3.



SMITH, SIR JOHN SMALAN, KT. BACH (1896).—M.A., St. John's Coll., Camb.; b. 1847; called to the bar, In. Term., 1872; special pleader Oxford circuit; puisne judge, G. Coast Col., 1883; judge, Lagos, 1886; ch. just., Lagos, 1889; ret., 1895.



SMITH, LINDSAY LEA.—B. 1870; ag. clk. to comsnr., Turks Is., 1894, 1896, 1900, and 1903; confirmed 1st July, 1903; ag. acctnt. and clk. (collr. of customs, postmtr., cashier and regir. of shipping) comsnr.'s office, June to Sept., 1904, and May to Aug., 1906; acctnt. and clk. (collr. of cust., postmtr., cashier, and regir. of shipping), Jan., 1907; gen. man., savings bank, 1st July, 1907.



SMITH, RICHARD WILLIAM, A.M.I.C.E., B.A., B.A.I., P.W. Dept., Ceylon; B. 1856; ed. at the Grammar Sch., Chard, Somerset, 1874, and Dublin Univ. (Trinity College), 1875-79; employed in engineer's off., D.W.W. Rlyw., 1879; res. engr., Wicklow Harb. works, 1880-83; asst. to Mr. J. Lanyon, Belfast (rlyws., waterworks, drainage, etc.), 1883-85; res. engr., Cleggan Harb. Works, 1885-88; asst. res. engr., St. Helier's Harb. Works (Jersey), 1888-89; supt. P.W., Pahang, S.S., 1889-92; D.E., P.W.D., Ceylon, 1892-94; ag. prov. engrnr., N.W.P., 1894-97; dist. engrnr. and ag. prov. engr., S.P., 1898; seconded to railway extensions staff, 1899; seconded to "Water Supply Schemes," 1898-1900; charge of Boer Camp Works, 1900; "Water Supply Schemes," 1901-02; seconded as res. engr., proposed convict prison works, Seychelles, 1902; returned to Ceylon 13th Aug., 1902; engaged in designs of water supplies to the towns of Negombo, Jaffna, Pamban (S. India), Mannar, Galle and Matare; asst. dir. of irrigtn., Colombo, 1st Jan., 1905; ag. dir., 1906.



SMITH, ROBERT MURRAY, C.M.G. (1884).—B. 1831; agt.-gen. for Victoria in United Kingdom, 1881-86.



SMITH, HON. SYDNEY.—M.P. for Macquarie, New South Wales; postmtr.-gen., Commonwealth of Australia, in Reid-Turner ministry, 1904.



SMITH, SYDNEY FREDERICK, F.R.G.S.—B. 1870; clk. in treasy., Fiji, 22nd May, 1893; clk., native dept., 1st Jan., 1894; stip. mag., and tax inspr., Kadavu (in addition to duties as clk. in native dept.), 1st Jan., 1896; ch. clk., native dept., 4th Feb., 1897; prov. inspr., 1st Jan., 1899; ag. stip. mag., tax inspr., and asst nat. comsnr., Lau Archipelago, 13th Jan., 1902; ditto, Lautoka, 21st Jan., 1903; asst. nat. comsnr., 1st Jan., 1904; sub-collr. of cust. and postmtr., Lautoka, 6th May, 1904; on leave from Apr., 1903, to Mar., 1905, and acted as war corres. with Gen. Oku's forces in Russo-Japanese war; ag. stip. mag. and tax inspr., Lautoka, from 15th Apr., 1907.



SMITH, THOMAS SERCOMBE, B.A., LL.B. (Lond.).—Hong Kong cadet, 1882; attached to C.O., 1883; passed cadet, 1886; ag. asst. registrar-gen., 1886-90, except for five months as ag. pol. mag.; asst. registrar-gen., 1891; called to the bar, Mid. Term., Nov., 1893; ag. puisne judge, various dates, 1895-7, and in 1900, 1901, 1902, 1904 and 1905; trans., Dec., 1896; pol. mag., July, 1898; ag. col. sec., 1898-9, for 3 months in 1901, and from Aug., 1905, to Dec., 1906.



SMITH, WM. EDWARD.—Employed on L. & N.W. Rly., 1872-82; asst. traffic man., Indian guaranteed rlys. (Scinde, Punjab, and Delhi), 1883-86; ag. district traffic man., Lahore and Delhi div.; gen. man., Barbados Rly., 1889; gen. and traffic man., Trinidad Govt. Rly., Feb., 1894; visited Jamaica and reported on Banana industry, 1901; comsnr. for Trinidad, Colonial and Indian Exhibn., London, 1905; is a J.P.; gen. man. of govt. rlys., G. Coast, 1906; major comit., rly. volrs., May, 1907; offl. mem., Sekondi town council.



SMITH, SIR WILLIAM FREDERICK HAYNES, K.C.M.G. (1890), C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1839; called to the bar, Mid. Term., June, 1873; solr.-gen., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1865; atty.-gen., Oct., 1874; admstr. the govt., Apr. to Sept., 1884, and in 1887; gov., Leeward Is., Nov., 1888; gov., Bahamas, 1895; high comsnr., Cyprus, 1898-1904.



SMITH, SIR WILLIAM JAMES, KT. BACH (1896).—M.A., LL.M., Trinity Hall, Camb.; b.1853; acted as puisne judge of the G. Coast Col. from Dec. 1880, to July, 1881; puisne judge of the sup. ct. of Cyprus, 1882; ch. just., 1892; ch. just., Br. Guiana, 1898; puisne judge, sup. ct., Transvaal, 1st Mar., 1902.



SMITH, WILLIAM RAMSAY.—B.Sc., M.B., M.S., Edin.; chmn. cent. bd. of health, coroner, vaccination offr., and inspr. of anatomy, S. Australia, 1889-1903; chmn. cent. bd. of health, and coroner, 1903.



SMITH-STEINMETZ, GERARD ARCHIBALD JOHN.—B. 1878; ed. at Stonyhurst coll.; cadet, Straits Settlements, Oct., 1902; in charge of S.S. emigr. depot, S. India, June, 1904; passed final exam. in Tamil, July, 1904; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Feb., 1905; passed cadet, July, 1905; ag. dist. offr., Nibong-Tebal, Sept., 1906.

SMUTS, GEN. THE HON. JAN CHRISTIANN.—B. 1870; ed. at Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; B.A., Cape Univ., 1891; Elden scholar at Christ's Coll., Camb.; double first in law tripos, 1891; barrister, Cape Col.; state-attorney, S. African Republic, 1898; served with Boer forces during S. African war, and was in comd. of Boer forces in Cape Col. during the latter part of the campaign; mem. of head comitee. of Het Volk; col. sec., Transvaal, 1907.



SMUTS, JOHANNES.—Cllk., treasy., Cape, 1882; acted as priv. sec. to the Hon. J. Gordon Sprigg, 1885-6; to Sir H. A. Smyth, 1889; to Lieut.-Gen. H. E. Cameron, and to Sir H. Loch, 1891; sec. to Hon. J. H. Hofmeyr (Swaziland Convention), 1890; asst. despatch clk., govt. house, 1886; 2nd class clk., 1887; ag. priv. sec. to Lieut.-Gen. Cameron and to Sir H. B. Loch, 1891 to 1895; ch. clk. to high comsnr., 1891; acted as elk. of exec. coun., 1891 and 1895; Br. consul in Swaziland, Aug., 1895-9; served on staff of Sir C. Warren during part of S. African war; regis. of deeds, Apr., 1903; chmn. of Swaziland concessions comsnr., 1904.



SMYLY, ST PHILIP CRAMPTON, KT. BACH. (1905).—B. 1866; ed. at Trin. Coll., Dub., B.A., LL.B.; called to the bar, King's Inns, Dub., 1888; LL.D., 1891; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1902; Queen's advoc., S. Leone, 1895; atty.-gen., 1896; ch. just., S. Leone, 1901.



SMYTH, C. E. OWEN, I.S.O. (1903).—B. 1851; ed. at Erasmus Smith Schil., Dub.; specification clk., S. Australia, 1876; profnl. clk., 3rd class, 1878; 1st class, 1883; supt. of pub. bldgs. and head of works and bldgs. dept., S. Aust., 1886.



SMYTH, HERBERT WARINGTON.—B. 1867; ed. at Westmstr. and Trin. Coll., Camb., M.A., L.M., F.G.S., F.R.G.S., barr.-at-law; advoc. of sup. ct., Transvaal; unpaid asst. to mineral adviser to office of woods, 1891; sec., dept. of mines, Siam, 1891; director-gen. of mines and geological survey, Siam, 1895; sec., Siamese Legation, 1897 (order of White Elephant, 3rd cls.); Murchison award of R.G.S. for travels in Siam, 1898; sec. to mines dept., Transvaal, 1901; M.L.C., Transvaal, 1906; mem. exec. coun. while ag. comsnr. of mines, 1906; sec. for mines, 1907; author of "Five Years in Siam," "Mast and Sail in Europe and Asia," papers on Indo-China, etc., etc.



SMYTH, JAMES LLOYD.—B. 1871; served in R.I.C. from 1889 to 1897; transf'd. from detec. dept., Belfast, to Jamaica constab., Sept., 1897; ag. supt., M. and S. co. gaol, Sept., 1900, to Feb., 1901; asst. sup. of pol., Br. Hond., July, 1906; J.P. for colony; ag. supt. of pol., 20th Sept., to 26th Oct., 1906; vis. just. to Corozal and dist. pris., Dec., 1906; ag. supt. of pol., 4th Apr., 1907, to 3rd Mar., 1908; vis. just. to Belize pris., June, 1907.



SNOWBALL, JABEZ BUNTING.—Lieut.-gov., New Brunswick, Canada, 1902-1907.



SOLOMON, JOHN.—2nd class asst. of excise, England, Apr., 1868; 1st class asst., June, 1870; ride offr., June, 1871; resig., Jan., 1876; ag. 3rd elk., immigr. dept., Br. Guiana, July, 1877; ag. cashier in rec-gen.'s office, 1878; comsry. of taxation, 1879.



SOLOMON, MICHAEL CLAUDE.—Ag. 3rd elk., island med. dept., Jamaica, Mar., 1885; 3rd cl. elk., Oct., 1888; 2nd cl. elk., July, 1891.



SOLOMON, HON. SIR RICHARD, K.C.B. (1905), K.C.M.G. (1901), K.C.V.O. (1907), C.B. (1903), K.C.—B. 1850; ed. S. African Coll., Capetown; St. Peter's Coll., Camb., 23rd wrangler; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1879; legal adviser to late Lord Rosemead on his mission to Mauritius, 1886; mem. of native law comsnr.; chmn. of mining comsnr.; mem. of House of Ass. for division of Tembuland, Cape; atty.-gen., Cape, 1898-1900; legal adviser to Transvaal admininstr., 1901-1902; atty.-gen., Transvaal, 19th June, 1902; mem. el. and leg. couns.; mem. I.C.C.; ag. lieut.-gov., Transvaal, 1905.



SOLOMON, SIR WM. HENRY, KT. BACH. (1907).—B.A., Cantab.; admitted to the bar, Inner Temple, 1877; practised in Cape Colony; asst. legal adviser, Cape, 1883; puisne judge, sup. ct., 1887; sec., spec. treason court, 1900; 1st puisne judge, Transvaal, 1902.



SOUZA, SIMON ISIDORO DE.—B. 1863; ed. at the R. Catholic gram. schil., Lagos; 1st despatch clk. and shorthand writer, col. sec.'s office, Lagos, June, 1895; acted as clk. of the legis. coun., 1900; registr. of correspondence, June, 1900; conf. clk. to gov. and clk. of leg. coun., July, 1901; ag. priv. sec. to gov., and clk. to exec. coun., Feb., 1902; in charge of Ibadan residency, Nov., 1903.



SORZANO, TILDEBER.—Draughtsman, crown lands office, Trinidad, 1874; first ditto, survey dept., Aug., 1881.



SPALDING, COL. WARNER WRIGHT, C.M.G. (1885).—B. 1844; lieut., Royal Marines, 1842-1869; carried colours in operations at Simonosehie, Japan, 1864; N. S. Wales artill., 1871-1896; 2nd in cmdt. of N.S.W. Soudan conting., 1885; ch. mag. Norfolk Is., 1896-1898.



SPEED, EDWIN ARNEY.—M.A., LL.B.; B. 1869; ed. at Rugby, and Trin. Coll., Camb.; major scholar and senior exhibtnr., Rugby schil.; scholar and prize-man of Trin. Coll., Camb.; 1st cls. class. tripos, 1890; 2nd cls. law tripos, Part I., 1891; called to the bar, Inner Temple, June, 1893; dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 1899; atty.-gen., Lagos, 1900; edited a revised edition of Lagos laws, 1901; has acted on numerous occasions as ch. just. and also as col. sec., from Jan., 1905, to Mar., 1906; atty.-gen., S. Nigeria, May, 1906; edited revised editn. of laws of S. Nigeria, 1907.



SPENCE, FRANK.—B. 1864; 3rd elk. col. sec.'s offr., Fiji, 1880; clk. to comsnrs. of wks., Oct., 1884; ag. priv. sec. to gov., 1884, 1885, and 1887 to 1896; sec. to consul-gen. for W. Pacific, 1889 to 1896; stip. mag., Cakandrove and Bua, 1896 to 1898; provincial inspr. and stip. mag., Cakandrove and Bua, 1899; ditto, Cakandrove, 1901; gov.'s comsnr. for Namosi and stip. mag., Navua, Jan., 1904.



SPENCE, J. B.—Med. supt. of Colombo lun. asyl., Ceylon, 1886.



SPENCE, R. O. H.—Cler. asst., P.W. dept., Br. Guiana, 16th Aug., 1886; ag. 2nd cl. elk., P.W. dept., Aug., 1889; ag. 3rd cl. elk., treasy., Jan., 1890; gov't. offr., gov't. ld. dept., Apr., 1890; clk., gov't. id. dept., May, 1890; sec., Bartika comsnrs., June, 1891, to May, 1893; elk., dept. mines, Oct., 1892; ag. 3rd cl. elk., dept. mines, Apr., 1893; gov't offr., dept. mines, July, 1893; J.P., May, 1894; comsnr. to admr. oathls., June, 1894; dist. gov't offr., dept. mines, Aug., 1896; warden, dept. mines, Nov., 1896; obt'd. certif. as sworn land surv., June, 1898; ag. ch. elk., dept. mines, Feb., 1900; obtained 1st cls. certifs. in assaying and mine survg., Camborne schl. of mines, 1902; elected assoc., Inst. of M. and M., Lond., Apr., 1902; 1st cls. offr., dept. of lands and mines, Apr., 1903; ag. asst. comsnr. of lands and mines, Apr. to Dec., 1904; 1st cls. elk., dept. of lands and mines, July, 1905; ch. elk., ditto, Oct., 1905; ag. comsnr., ditto, June to Aug., 1906.

SPENCER, CYRIL EDWARD.—B. 1873; entd. col. serv., Cyprus, 1st Mar., 1891; in secretariat from Apr., 1892, to May, 1898; also clk. to legis. coun., Mar., 1894, to May, 1898; priv. sec. to high comsnr. on several occasions, 1898-1900; inspr., mil. pol., 1st May, 1898; ag. dist. comdt., July, 1900, to Jan., 1904; apptd. in comd. of div. of pol., Jan., 1904; also gov. of pris. and asst. to dist. comsnr., and dep. coroner; ag. dist. comsnr., Apr. to Dec., 1906; passed in mod. Greek, higher standard, 1904; and in Turkish, lower standard, 1906; transf. to B. East Africa, as asst. dist. comsnr., Nov., 1906; ag. supt., inland rev., Apr. to Oct., 1907; ag. dist. comsnr., Mombasa, from July, 1907.



SPIRE, JOHN.—B. 1865; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s dept., Tobago, 1884; 1st clk., audit and registry dept., 1884; 2nd rev. offr., 1885; harbrmr. and landing waiter, 1880; supervisor of excise 1892; inspr. of pol., 1896; in charge of prison, 1897; asst. harbrmr., Trinidad, 1899; sub-registr., sup. ct., and clk. of the peace, 1907.



SPITRE, JOHN.—B. 1860; apptd., after exam., 3rd class messenger, C.O., Jan., 1883; 2nd class, July, 1896; Queen's mess., Nov., 1899.



SPRIGG, THE RT. HON. SR. JOHN GORDON, P.C. (1897), G.C.M.G. (1902), K.C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1830; represented E.
